topic: B2B Personalization and the AI-Driven Buyer Journey
headline: AI Raises The Bar For B2B Personalization, Again
keyNotes: Even if you send personalized emails or special landing pages, that's often not enough because today's business buyers (who are also using AI to help them) expect companies to truly understand their specific goals and situation throughout their entire buying process.

While a large majority (71%) of B2B marketers are using AI to create or adjust content for different audiences, far fewer (only 23%) are using AI to actually build or change entire customer experiences in real-time based on what a buyer is doing right now.

Surprisingly, the most effective way to personalize for business customers is by understanding their specific needs at that moment, but this powerful technique isn't among the most commonly used by marketers.
AI is changing how companies personalize by allowing them to move beyond simple, pre-planned messages to create dynamic, real-time experiences that adapt instantly to what a group of buyers is doing.
question: The article points out that while many use AI to create content, far fewer use it to adapt entire experiences in real-time based on what someone is doing or needing right now. In your own field, where could you move beyond just creating static information and instead use technology to dynamically adjust your approach to better meet someone's immediate, evolving needs?
